s: Haqqore basseper venitgalgel mereshut lirshut ubo d' seipim: haqqore al haisquppa beseper missipre haqqodesh heasuy biglila keseper tora, venitgalgel rosh haechad mehasseper miyyado lirshut harabbim shellipne haisquppa, verosh hashsheni nishar beyado — golelo etzlo, apillu nitgalgel chutz led' ammot. Veap al pi shehaisquppa hi reshut hayyachid, sheyyesh aleha mashqop rachab d', hittiru, mishshum bizyon kitbe haqqodesh — sherabbim doresim al haisquppa — sheen biglila zo issur tora, hoil verosh hashsheni nishar beyado, vekol hazzoreq dabar lirshut harabbim verosh hashsheni beyado, im yakol lahabio etzlo al yede zeh — patur, sheen kan hannacha birshut harabbim. Velaken muttar lachazor velahabio etzlo min hattora. Ella shechakamim aseru zeh bishar debarim, gezera shemma yippol kullo miyyado lirshut harabbim vibiennu etzlo. Abal bimqom bizyon kitbe haqqodesh lo gazeru gezera zo. Abal im napal kol hasseper miyyado, apillu napal lekarmelit — asur lahabio etzlo, shello hittiru shebut gamur kazeh mishshum bizyon kitbe haqqodesh:

Ubishar debarim, apillu napal lekarmelit verosh hashsheni beyado — asur lahabio etzlo (velo ameru shebbekarmelit lo gazeru gezera mippene shehu gezera ligzera ella bedabar sheen bo derek melaka, kegon haomed birshut hayyachid veshoteh birshut harabbim shennitbaer besimman sh"n, o hazzoreq mereshut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid derek meqom petur sheyyitbaer besimman shn"g, o hayyotze lirshut harabbim mibbeod yom samuk lachasheka vechepetz beyado shennitbaer besimman rn"b. Abal dabar shehu domeh limlaka, gazeru ap bekarmelit. Velaken yesh oserim lehotzi mereshut hayyachid lekarmelit derek meqom petur, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v. Velaken aseru letaltel pachot pachot mid' ammot bekarmelit, kemo shennitbaer besimman (sh"n) [shm"t]. Velaken aseru melaka sheenah tzerika legupah bekarmelit, kemo shennitbaer besimman shy"a. Vehu haddin lehotzaa kilachar yad veken kol kayyotze baellu):

Haya qore bo al haggag, shehu reshut hayyachid, venitgalgel (hasseper) miyyado rosho haechad — ad shello higgi laasara tepachim hattachtonim haqqerobim laaretz, golelo etzlo, sheavir meqom petur hu. Vaapillu nach al gabbe ziz, im eno rachab d' hu gam ken meqom petur, vaapillu im rachab d' — hu reshut hayyachid (o karmelit, al derek sheyyitbaer besimman shn"g, gam ken en issur bahabaato oto mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid, kevan sherosho haechad beyado, ukemo sheyyitbaer). Abal im higgia ley' tepachim hattachtonim, shehem avir reshut harabbim, im hakkotel meshuppa beinyan shennach alayv — asur legolelo etzlo, gezera shemma yippol kullo shamma vibiennu etzlo veyitchayyeb. Velo ameru shello gazeru gezera zo bekitbe haqqodesh ella beisquppa shedderek rabbim oberim aleha, shezzehu bizzayon gadol, sherabbim doresim sham. Abal kan sheen derisat haregel oberet sham, ap al pi shehasseper muttal kak birshut harabbim, shezzehu bizzayon lo — asur legolelo etzlo, ella yahapkennu al hakketab kede lemaet habbizzayon, shekkeshehakketab megulleh hu bizzayon yoter. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesherabbim mekattepim al shippua hakkotel, sheaz dino kirshut harabbim gemura, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h. Abal im en rabbim mekattepim alayv — karmelit hu, ubekarmelit lo gazeru gezera zo bekitbe haqqodesh shemmuttalim bebizzayon. Veim en hakkotel meshuppa, ap al pi shehu birshut harabbim verabbim mekattepim alayv, kevan shello nach hasseper alayv — muttar legoll[o] etzlo kol zeman shello higgia laaretz, sheen ligzor shemma yippol kullo vibiennu, lepi sheap im yippol kullo lirshut harabbim velo yanuach sham ella yehe taluy baavir reshut harabbim — muttar leqolto min haavir velahabio lirshut hayyachid min hattora, ella sheasur middibre soperim benapal kullo. Ubenapal miqtzato lo gazeru bimqom kitbe haqqodesh hammuttalim bebizzayon:

Abal bishar debarim, apillu lo napal ella miqtzato laavir reshut harabbim velo nach sham — asur lahabio etzlo. Abal im napal laavir karmelit velo nach sham — muttar lahabio etzlo im rosho haechad nishar beyado (vehu haddin shemmuttar lehotzio lekattechilla laavir karmelit im rosho haechad beyado shehi birshut hayyachid veenah peshuta lachutz):
